Journey_Title: Trade-in / Appraisal Management Setup Data & Reference Entities
Pre_Requisites: Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ completed; Vehicle Definition reference data already loaded (MMY catalog); Business Brand & Catalog already loaded; Code Sets exist for Condition / Exterior Colour / Mileage UoM / Owner; Auto_Vehicle_Data_UJ available so Vehicle records can be referenced by VIN# search.
Business_Process: Reference data → Master picklist value sets → Vehicle Definition / Product graph → Asset graph → Lead / Opportunity graph → Approval routing user graph → Community user graph → Telemetry baseline
Detailed_Scenarios:
Scenario Overview: SDET / Implementation Consultant declares the read-only data graph that must exist before any Appraisal transaction can run. This is documentation-only — no rows are inserted by this journey (project org is read-only).

Step-by-Step:
1. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Interest Type: 'Valuation', 'Sales', 'Trade-in' (Appraisal field).
2. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Appraisal Status (partner-defined; example smoke set: Draft → In Valuation → Pending Approval → Approved → Rejected → Inspection Scheduled → Final).
3. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Adjustment Type on Appraisal Adjustment: Markup, Discount, Reconditioning Cost, Dents and Scratches, Mark-up Profit Margin (each can be % or absolute per Epic field doc).
4. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Condition (Excellent / Good / Average / Rough) — must be a picklist (Epic flags this gap; see Notes).
5. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Exterior Colour (must be a picklist; closed list per Epic).
6. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Mileage UoM (Miles, Km).
7. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Owner / Hand-off count (1, 2, 3+).
8. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Usage UoM (Hours / Cycles / Miles / Km — used on Asset Appraisal Item).
9. [SDET] Reference picklist values for Market Source on Appraisal Item Provider Valuation (KBB, JD Power, Black Book, Manheim, Custom Provider).
10. [SDET] Vehicle Definition graph: Make → Model → Year → Style/Trim/Variant rows that the dealer can pick when manually entering vehicle details (Process Flow path: Vehicle Found in Inventory? = No → Manual entry).
11. [SDET] Vehicle graph: at least one VIN-resolvable Vehicle record per smoke run so 'Search by VIN#' auto-populates make / model / year / style / mileage. Field map: VIN, License Plate, State, Last Odometer Reading, Style.
12. [SDET] Asset graph (for Trade-in Asset RT testing): Asset record with AIN#, Make, Model, Year, Product Family, Install Date, Purchase Date, Warranty End Date.
13. [SDET] Asset Warranty graph: at least one Asset Warranty record so Wrranty End Date populates on the Vehicle Appraisal Item (Existing Field linkage per Epic).
14. [SDET] Product graph: ProductRelatedComponent rows under AccessoryProduct so Appraisal Accessories Attributes can lookup Related Product (rooftop, leather seats, advanced sound systems, etc.).
15. [SDET] Lead graph: Lead with Lead Line Item so Epic 1 (initiate appraisal from Lead) and Epic 14 (link appraised vehicle to Lead Line Item / Quote in 256) are testable.
16. [SDET] Opportunity graph: Opportunity with Opportunity Product + Opportunity Line Item so Epic 14 (Opportunity Line Item link) is testable in 256.
17. [SDET] Account graph: Person Account or Business Account + Contact pair so 'initiate appraisal from Account / Vehicle Console / Asset Console' (Epic 1) is testable.
18. [SDET] Approver graph: at least one Finance Manager user with the Appraisal_Finance_Manager PS so the Approval Process can route. Email enabled.
19. [SDET] Community user graph (256+): Partner Community user + Customer Community user with Appraisal_External_Community_User PS so Epic 10 (process Appraisal as external user) can be tested.
20. [SDET] Action Plan Templates for Inspection Visit (Epic 11 / 256): one template with steps for physical inspection, document checklist, and KPI capture.
21. [SDET] Document Checklist Items: required documents for trade-in (registration, insurance, identity proof, ownership transfer form).
22. [SDET] Telemetry baseline counters: capture initial counts of Appraisal / Appraisal Item / Appraisal Adjustment / Appraisal Item Provider Valuation records before each test run, so post-run telemetry deltas (per Epic Telemetry section) can be asserted.
23. [SDET] Test data shape:
   - Smoke: 1 Vehicle, 1 Lead, 1 Opportunity, 1 Person Account, 1 Asset, 1 approver.
   - Regression: 10 Vehicles spanning 3 Makes / 5 Models / 3 Years; 5 Leads in different stages; 5 Opportunities; 5 Assets including 1 Battery RT; 2 approvers.
   - Performance: 1k Appraisals, 5k Appraisal Items, 20k Appraisal Item Provider Valuations (validate Telemetry counters and approval throughput).
24. [SDET] Idempotency note: every fixture is keyed by stable external ID (VIN for Vehicle, AIN for Asset, Lead.Email for Lead, External_Id__c on test users) so the read-only describe step is repeatable against any sandbox.
Features_Mapped: Vehicle Definition, Vehicle, Asset, Asset Warranty, ProductRelatedComponent (AccessoryProduct), Lead + Lead Line Item, Opportunity + Opportunity Product, Account (Person + Business), Contact, User, Action Plan Templates, Document Checklist Items, Picklist Value Sets, Telemetry counters
Complexity:
Smoke - P0
Regression - P1
Performance - P2

Vehicle-only data graph - P0
Vehicle + Asset (Battery / Equipment) graph - P1
Vehicle + Asset + Community user graph - P2
Frequency: Once per sandbox refresh; reverified after every release upgrade
Setup_Required: Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ completed; org-pref ON; permission sets assigned; OmniStudio assets imported.
Expected_Outcome: Read-only data contract is documented and verifiable. Every TUJ step has a named Setup-Data row supplying its inputs. Telemetry baselines are captured so post-run deltas are assertable.
Integration_Points: Source providers (read-only): existing Vehicle / Asset / Vehicle Definition data already in sandbox; no live external valuation calls during Setup Data step.
Performance_Requirements: Describe / SOQL of fixture sets < 10s for smoke, < 60s for regression.
